business_problem: Accenture's earlier cloud estate still relied on workloads that were not rearchitected for cloud-native operations, while siloed ERP systems and manual data gathering made it hard to get a unified real-time view of the business or use AI-driven insights efficiently across functions.
solution_summary: Accenture used Google Cloud to rebuild its own enterprise foundation as a cloud-native operating environment instead of a basic lift-and-shift migration. The transformation moved application delivery into automated pipelines, containerized services, and scalable cloud infrastructure so engineers could provision environments in minutes. At the data layer, Accenture consolidated enterprise information from HR, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other functions into a cloud-native data lake on Google Cloud with BigQuery providing analysis and reporting. That foundation powers business-management dashboards that combine diverse sources in real time, while a legal contract management system uses BigQuery, Google Translate API, AI, and natural language processing to translate documents, detect trends, flag risks, and verify policies. The resulting architecture gives Accenture a unified digital core for ongoing analytics, machine learning, governance, and enterprise-scale process automation.

solution_components.role: Provides the cloud-native infrastructure, services, and security model Accenture uses to run, operate, and innovate across its global IT environment.

solution_components.role: Helps the legal contract management workflow translate documents before AI and NLP identify trends, risks, and policy issues.

solution_components.name: automated delivery pipelines
solution_components.role: Automate software provisioning, coding, testing, and release so new applications can be built and deployed rapidly.

data_flow: Enterprise data from HR, Sales, Legal, Finance, and proprietary applications flows into a cloud-native data lake on Google Cloud. BigQuery and related AI services analyze those integrated datasets in real time for dashboards and operational workflows, while specialized services such as Google Translate API feed contract documents into AI and NLP processes that surface risks, trends, and policy issues for end users.
business_outcome: Accenture achieved a simpler and faster cloud operating model, created a governed real-time data foundation, reduced manual review work in legal processes, lowered infrastructure costs, and improved sustainability while building a reusable enterprise architecture for future AI use cases.
